• BuiltDevPulse, an HR activity monitoring platform onNode.js/Express, PostgreSQL, and AWS S3, where a
Windows PowerShell collector on employee machines sends hourly activity JSON via REST; full report payloads are stored in
S3using date-partitioned object keys while searchable metadata and dashboard indexes live inPostgreSQL.
• Implemented alayered backend(handler→service→repository) withSnowflake IDs, report upserts enforced by a
UNIQUEemployee/time-window constraint, consistent typed HTTP errors, and asyncOpenAIsecurity analysis decoupled
from the upload response through background jobs.
• Designed ahybrid AI scoring pipelinethat combines deterministic URL/domain tagging (personal messaging,
job-hunting, entertainment) with LLM-based risk scoring (risk level,risk score, structuredfindings[]), using prompts,
JSON-mode responses, and server-side validation before persisting results.
• Shipped aReact (Vite)HR dashboard usingMUI and TanStack Query, featuring employee and report views with
S3-backed detail access, an AI risk panel with status polling and manual re-run, plusDocker Composeorchestration and a
Windows collector deployment bundle (Task Scheduler,sqlite3).
